info.title: PayLap Settlement API
info.description: Multi-tenant settlement API for verified-delivery payment holds.

get.description: Liveness probe: verifies the process is responsive.

Readiness probe:
- Verifies PostgreSQL database is reachable
- Verifies Alembic migrations are applied to head
- Verifies background job heartbeat freshness

post.description:
Create a new milestone contract and initialize PayPal escrow order.
Enforces Row-Level Security, spend policies, hidden test commitments, and idempotency.

get.description:
List contracts with cursor-based pagination and filtering.
Enforces Row-Level Security for the authenticated organization.

Get detailed contract information including milestones (never hidden_tests)
and recent ledger events.

schema.title: Response Get Contract Detail V1 Contracts  Contract Id  Get

get.description:
Redirect endpoint called by PayPal when buyer approves authorization.
Verifies cryptographic signed state token and transitions contract to FUNDED.
Called when buyer cancels approval at PayPal checkout.

post.description:
Submit work for a milestone.
Runs injection scan, isolated verifiers, fail-closed LLM arbiter veto layer, and capture/payouts.
Buyer cancellation: voids remaining hold if funded, or marks cancelled if awaiting funding.

get.description: Generate and return a signed, tamper-evident cryptographic receipt for the contract.

post.description:

Requires receipts:read permission.

schema.title: Response Create Receipt Share Token V1 Contracts  Contract Id  Share Post

get.description:
Public verification endpoint to retrieve a cryptographic digital receipt via share token.
No authentication required. Rate-limited by IP.
Worker email is strictly masked; hidden tests are omitted.
